name: omakodi
author: Frestina
description: A keyboard remote for Kodi: send links to play or queue, drive Kodi's menus from the keyboard, and see what is playing in the bar.

barWidget.description: Shows Kodi while it answers and what it is playing; click for the remote.

schema.label: Show the title, up to this many characters (0: icon only)
YouTube links go to
schema.description: smart: the YouTube add-on, SendToKodi if it fails, and SendToKodi for 30 minutes after a failure. youtube-first: the YouTube add-on, SendToKodi if it fails. youtube-only: the YouTube add-on only. sendtokodi-only: SendToKodi only. Wins over youtubeMode in ~/.config/omakodi/config.json.
